{{Top|leg}}
'''Ore barges''' were a type of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The [[Eyttyrmin Batiiv]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] used a few dozen ore barges and [[cargo hauler]]s, mounted with weapons, as part of their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="ATPA">{{WEGCite|story=Against the Pirate Armada|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> Sub-[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] ore barges were employed on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] like [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] to transport [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from the domestic [[Mining/Legends|mines]] to [[Shulell City airport]].<ref name="LB">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref>

The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] employed [[Trade Federation ore barge|ore barges]] in its merchant fleet for centuries prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
